Hi Deb,

What browser are you trying to use? If you're using an older browser like Internet Explorer 6 or 7 on XP, you'll need to update to a more recent browser (like Firefox or Chrome) in order for all of the features in Shiny to work correctly.

Thanks,
Jeff
